# Vimeo

> > Vimeo is an all-in-one video platform providing video hosting, live streaming, on-demand content, and enterprise video solutions for creators and businesses.

Vimeo offers comprehensive video tools including Vimeo On Demand for independent film distribution, live event streaming, and enterprise video marketing solutions. The platform serves content creators, filmmakers, and organizations with professional video hosting and monetization capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Vimeo On Demand
- Live streaming
- Enterprise video solutions
- Video hosting and marketing
- Independent films and documentaries
- Webinars and events
- Video monetization
- Streaming rentals and purchases
- Product innovation
- Video catalog and categories
- Content distribution
- Professional video platform
- Creator tools

## Platform Overview

- [Vimeo - All-in-One Video Platform](https://vimeo.com/): Homepage for Vimeo's all-in-one video platform for creators & businesses

## Video Content & Catalog

- [Categories on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/categories): Browse video content by categories including animation, film, and travel
- [Browse | Vimeo On Demand](https://vimeo.com/ondemand/browse): Browse and rent/buy films on Vimeo On Demand streaming platform

## Live Events & Webinars

- [Vimeo Events, Live and On-Demand](https://vimeo.com/events): Explore Vimeo's live events, webinars, and on-demand video content
